rows.the-controller-picks-which-half-the-dupl: CR 712.21b: exiling the melded Chittering Host should put both Midnight Scavengers and Graf Rats into exile and let Duplicant's controller choose which one is the last creature card exiled. Observed: both cards reached exile, but no choice was offered, Duplicant took the 2/1 Rat body of Graf Rats, and the scripted Midnight Scavengers answer was left unconsumed.
